findings.highlight: I'll work according to my capabilities from now on.
findings.evidenceJa: ここからは体力と相談して悩もうと思ってます
findings.explanation: Haruki says that from here he will continue thinking through his unresolved problems while consulting or respecting his physical stamina. The translation turns that emotional recovery plan into a plan to work within his capabilities, reintroducing work where the source is discussing how safely to agonize and recover.
findings.japanese:
「それでも麻理さんのおかげで、
眠れるようにはなれました。
ここからは体力と相談して悩もうと思ってます」
findings.todokanai: "And of course, it's due to your efforts that I've finally been able to have some sleep. I'll work according to my capabilities from now on."
